description: Spend one of the user's monthly contact reveals to find decision-maker emails at a company, matched to the titles they sell to. Each revealed email is checked with a live mailbox verification and returned with a status (verified, risky, unknown, invalid) and the date. Use this when get_company_contacts returns nobody, or nobody with an email. Charges the monthly allowance (Strategic 600, Pro 150); tells the user what is left and how to upgrade when it runs out.

company.description: Company id or slug to reveal contacts at

include_mobile.description: Also attempt a mobile number. Costs considerably more than an email, so only when the user asks for a phone number.

name: reveal_contacts
title: Reveal contact emails
